summary_markdown:
The participants discussed scheduling a social gathering, initially proposing May 4th-5th at [me]'s property in Dnipro. Due to conflicting schedules (including family events and commitments), the date was tentatively set for May 4th-5th for a practice session focusing on grilling and general socializing. A follow-up gathering is planned for June.

Regarding the facility, [me] confirmed several improvements: the property is clean, repairs were made to furniture (a stool leg), and the tennis court will be rolled out soon. The venue can accommodate guests with partners/spouses, and separate rooms can be allocated.
decisions: The group will meet on May 4th-5th for a practice gathering.
A larger social gathering is planned for June.
